deliverables: Upgrade Cardano mainnet protocol from version 10.0 to 11.0 while remaining in the Conway era.
Enable new Plutus primitives defined in CIP-0109, CIP-0132, CIP-0133, CIP-0138 and CIP-0153.
Make all Plutus built-in functions available consistently across Plutus V1, V2 and V3.
Add UPLC case expressions over Bool, Integer and Data.
Promote or tighten several ledger and node validation, diagnostics, and security rules.
request.what: Initiate an intra-era hard fork upgrading Cardano Mainnet to protocol version 11.0, called the van Rossem hard fork.

claims.claim: The proposal upgrades Cardano Mainnet to protocol version 11.0 through an intra-era hard fork while keeping the ledger in the Conway era and preserving transaction shape.

The upgrade introduces Plutus primitives from CIP-0109, CIP-0132, CIP-0133, CIP-0138 and CIP-0153, including modular exponentiation, dropList, BLS12-381 multi-scalar multiplication, Array operations and native Value operations.
The proposal states that all Plutus built-in functions, including newly introduced ones, will become available across Plutus V1, V2 and V3.
The proposal states that UPLC case expressions over Bool, Integer and Data will improve performance and produce cleaner script logic.

The proposal claims testing reports demonstrate no behavioral regressions, complete conformance between specification and implementation for new ledger rules, and correct operation of new Plutus primitives and case expressions across Plutus V1, V2 and V3.

The proposal links a Cardano Node 11.0.1 performance report and states it shows no regressions for standard value, Plutus and voting benchmarks plus acceptable baseline performance for new primitives and case expressions.
The proposal states that security audits were undertaken for Plutus BLS primitives and execution costs for all Plutus primitives.

The proposal states that at least 85% of stake pools by active stake should have upgraded to a node version supporting protocol version 11 before ratification, and that insufficient upgrade status means the action should not be ratified.

The proposal asserts consistency with all eight relevant Cardano Constitution hard fork guardrails, while noting none can be checked by the automated guardrails script and HARDFORK-04 depends on pre-ratification stake pool upgrade status.

The proposal states reversion is only possible in extreme circumstances via the CIP-0135 disaster recovery process, while Plutus primitive usage could be disabled by changing companion cost model settings if issues are discovered.

summary: The document requests a non-treasury hard fork initiation to protocol version 11.0, emphasizing Plutus capability and performance improvements, ledger consistency changes, node diagnostics, constitutional guardrail consistency, SPO readiness requirements and limited reversion options.
